theme: An open day tucked in front of a full one.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Today is largely yours — a single telehealth check-in, then room to clear the overdue list and get set for a heavy medical day in Portland tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Lock Mike's surgery logistics
needsAttention.detail: Today's line on the oral-surgery prep list: confirm the driver to and from Portland and pin down insurance coverage and what's owed, ahead of Thursday's extraction. Prescriptions and soft food are tomorrow's job.

needsAttention.title: Pick a call time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: Eugenia offered slots for a PRI catch-up and is waiting to hear which works. Her Monday window has passed and Thursday collides with the surgery, so a fresh time needs proposing.

needsAttention.title: Book the Croatia flights
needsAttention.detail: The Croatia flights have sat on the list since Friday; the fare window keeps narrowing the longer the booking waits.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Peter
flagged.detail: A note from Peter is sitting unanswered in your LinkedIn messages.

flagged.title: Two new public-policy roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged a VP of Government Relations & Public Policy and a State Affairs executive role matching your searches.

flagged.title: Valoris follow-ups from Mike Lubrano
flagged.detail: Two notes from Mike Lubrano — a 'Dan and Mike follow up' and a nudge about Morningstar exiting the Sustainalytics stewardship business and its now-loose clients.

inbox.noise: The usual drift: Lumosity and Fog Linen promos, ICGN Paris, Nautilus Sailing, and the Midcoast/Nextdoor Maine newsletters.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

resolved.title: Boat shortlist came back
resolved.detail: Dan Mac replied with cruising-boat ideas — a Nicholson 31, Cape Dorys, and a Luders 33 up in Penobscot — nothing needed from you.

resolved.title: Maine ferry tickets confirmed
resolved.detail: The Maine State Ferry order came through confirmed.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer on the Maine coast has the farmstands at their peak, and a composed salad lets ripe tomatoes and briny French feta carry a warm, low-effort evening on your own.

acts.line: A quiet start with just the 10 o'clock telehealth visit on the books.
Wide open — a good stretch to clear the overdue pile: Croatia flights, travel bags, and the first pages of the new book.
Worth getting ahead of tomorrow's Portland run — throat ultrasound, brain MRI, then the Jomon call at 8.
